title: Account profile
description: Basic information for the signed-in account.

avatar.title: Avatar
avatar.description: Upload a profile picture for your account.
avatar.hint: PNG, JPEG, or WebP. Maximum file size is 5 MB.
avatar.too_large: Avatar must be at most 5 MB.

prefs.title: Timezone & language
prefs.description: Business dates (COB, posting dates, ranges) resolve in your timezone. Default is Asia/Ho_Chi_Minh.

appearance.title: Appearance
appearance.description: Applies to your account, in this browser only.

mode.title: Mode
mode.description: Dark mode is easier on the eyes for night shifts and EOD runs.

density.title: Density
density.description: Height of inputs, buttons and table rows.
density.compact_hint: Default. 36px rows, more data on screen.
density.comfortable_hint: 44px rows, easier to tap on touch screens.

font_scale.title: Text size
font_scale.description: Scales the whole interface up or down.

appearance.org_note: Brand colour, logo and chart palette are set by system administrators for the whole organisation.
